scope: Descriptive post-entry path analysis intended to identify exit-management hypotheses; it must not be used as an entry filter because the measurements occur after entry.

methodology.mae: Maximum adverse intrabar excursion from entry through the specified post-entry horizon, divided by recorded riskDistance
methodology.mfe: Maximum favorable intrabar excursion from entry through the specified post-entry horizon, divided by recorded riskDistance
methodology.antiLookahead: Early excursion is measured only after entry. No future excursion is used to classify an entry before it occurs.
methodology.importantWarning: These results are descriptive. A positive subgroup does not authorize a rule change. Any exit rule must be simulated prospectively and validated on untouched data.
